ideas.pitch: A dual-propulsion robotic vehicle combining catamaran hulls for open water mobility with caterpillar tracks for scaling muddy riverbanks to retrieve trapped plastic waste.
ideas.problem_statement: Design a robot that can move through open water and reach riverbank debris without getting stuck.
ideas.title: MudScout: Amphibious Bank-Crawler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the core hardware challenge explicitly by solving the difficult transition phase from water to muddy riverbanks where standard boats fail.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI camera module mounted on an RC collection vessel that identifies and logs types of riverbank garbage in real-time before mechanical retrieval.
ideas.problem_statement: Design a robot that can move through open water and reach riverbank debris without getting stuck.
ideas.title: TrashTrack Vision: AI Riverbank Debris Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages an unusual physical build paired with a proven computer vision winning pattern from past robotics hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight robotic arm with a scoop and gripping mechanism attached to a floating platform, specifically engineered to reach up mudbanks and pull down accumulated litter.
ideas.problem_statement: Design a robot that can move through open water and reach riverbank debris without getting stuck.
ideas.title: BankGrabber: Articulated Bank-Arm
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on mechanical execution and a working physical demo, which judges at a hardware hackathon heavily prioritize over abstract software.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous surface vessel equipped with solar panels and energy monitoring systems that tracks power efficiency while cruising shorelines for debris collection.
ideas.problem_statement: Design a robot that can move through open water and reach riverbank debris without getting stuck.
ideas.title: EcoRipple: Solar-Powered Autonomous Skimmer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines renewable energy metrics with hardware robotics, echoing past winning strategies focused on sustainability and power optimization.

ideas.pitch: A radar-emulating ultrasonic and depth-sensing sensor array mounted on a watercraft to map underwater obstacles and identify accessible shorelines for cleanup.
ideas.problem_statement: Design a robot that can move through open water and reach riverbank debris without getting stuck.
ideas.title: ShoreRadar: Obstacle and Bank Mapping Sonar
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings sophisticated mapping and sensor integration typically seen in autonomous vehicle hackathons into an environmental robotics context.
